graph.title: Space Rocket Ride

new_part_types.name: Round plate 2x2 with centre stud (dark blue)

notes: Element IDs are taken from the inventory pages 50-51; types not in the catalogue were added as new part types with ports guessed from the pictures.

Exact stud positions are not stated in the pictures, so which lower piece each part sits on is approximated (e.g. gray corner plates b3-b6, yellow bricks b11-b14, panel b48-b60 attachment to the yellow brick row, rocket parts to the red 4x6 plate b74).
Steps 26-30 parts are attached to the underside of the red 4x6 plate (b74 anti-stud.bottom); after the flip in step 31 later parts go on its top studs.
Two of the four '5' coins (b34, b35) are shown loose beside the model and have no connection; b32 and b33 are placed inside the red coin box.

Mechanism: crank (b24) turns the tan pin (b22); a 3-way connector (b45) on the white connectors drives the axle (b44) which carries the rocket via the round plate b87, rocking it. Joints are marked revolute.
The minifig (b139-b142) is built on page 5 and shown beside the model on page 48; it is not attached to the seat in the instructions.
Pairs of trans blue/green round plates (b116-b127) are listed individually, two per white bracket face; colour alternation is as in the picture.
The nose cone (b132) is held by the black rod b129 (inserted in Technic brick b103) via its centre hole; this is inferred from the picture.
